Mumbai eateries face license suspension over hygiene violations

The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has suspended the licenses of six eateries in Mumbai. The action was taken due to severe hygiene issues, including the presence of rats and cockroaches, and the discovery of expired food items. This crackdown highlights ongoing concerns about food safety standards in the city.
